summary_en: This phase 1 trial tests peposertib (M3814) combined with tuvusertib (M1774) in patients with advanced solid tumors that are metastatic or unresectable. Peposertib is taken by mouth once or twice daily on days 2 to 14 of cycle 1 and on days 1 to 14 of later cycles, and tuvusertib is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 14 of each cycle, with cycles repeating every 28 days. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; it says the study looks at safety, side effects and the best dose.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 evalúa peposertib (M3814) combinado con tuvusertib (M1774) en pacientes con tumores sólidos avanzados, metastásicos o no resecables. Peposertib se toma por vía oral una o dos veces al día en los días 2 al 14 del ciclo 1 y en los días 1 al 14 de los ciclos siguientes, y tuvusertib se toma por vía oral una vez al día en los días 1 al 14 de cada ciclo; los ciclos se repiten cada 28 días. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; señala que el estudio evalúa la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with a solid tumor that is metastatic or unresectable
Tumor with a stated alteration such as ATM mutation, MYC amplification, FBXW7 mutation, CCNE1 amplification, or SWI/SNF gene change
Progression on at least one prior standard therapy, or no standard therapy exists and the investigator deems it appropriate
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 (non-measurable disease allowed in dose escalation)
ECOG performance status 2 or better and life expectancy over 3 months
not_for: Immunotherapy within 21 days, radiation within 21 days, or major surgery within 21 days before cycle 1 day 1
Residual toxicity above grade 1 from prior anti-cancer therapy, with some exceptions
Pregnant or breastfeeding women, QTcF of 470 msec or more, or uncontrolled intercurrent illness
